title: Slow authorization readers can retain service capacity
connector: Common runtime; Envoy ext_authz and Traefik forwardAuth wrappers
profile: direct public bind only; shipped harness profiles bind loopback
summary: When the supported authorization-service 0.0.0.0 bind is directly reachable by untrusted clients, one incomplete HTTP request can retain the only synchronous receive loop and delay authorization-dependent traffic. Shipped Envoy and Traefik profiles keep this service loopback-only.
summary_de: Wenn der unterstützte 0.0.0.0-Bind des Authorization-Service direkt von nicht vertrauenswürdigen Clients erreichbar ist, kann eine unvollständige HTTP-Anfrage die einzige synchrone Receive-Schleife binden und authorization-abhängigen Traffic verzögern. Die ausgelieferten Envoy- und Traefik-Profile halten den Service loopbackgebunden.
observed_behavior: The listen parser accepts 0.0.0.0, accepted connections are processed synchronously, and header/body receive loops block without an absolute elapsed-time deadline, accepted-socket timeout, nonblocking state machine, or bounded admission control.
observed_behavior_de: Der Listen-Parser akzeptiert 0.0.0.0, angenommene Verbindungen werden synchron verarbeitet und Header-/Body-Receive-Schleifen blockieren ohne absolute Zeitgrenze, Accepted-Socket-Timeout, nichtblockierende State-Machine oder begrenzte Admission-Control.
expected_behavior: A directly exposed authorization-service listener must bound complete-request receipt time and preserve capacity for ordinary authorization clients without weakening existing fail-closed host semantics.
expected_behavior_de: Ein direkt exponierter Authorization-Service-Listener muss die Zeit für den vollständigen Request-Empfang begrenzen und Kapazität für normale Authorization-Clients bewahren, ohne bestehende fail-closed Host-Semantik abzuschwächen.
impact: Conditional Low/P3 availability risk for one configured service process and its authorization-dependent traffic. No authorization bypass, confidentiality loss, integrity impact, secret exposure, code execution, or cross-tenant effect is established.
impact_de: Bedingtes Low-/P3-Verfügbarkeitsrisiko für einen konfigurierten Service-Prozess und seinen authorization-abhängigen Traffic. Es sind kein Authorization-Bypass, kein Verlust der Vertraulichkeit, kein Integritätsimpact, keine Secret-Exposition, keine Codeausführung und kein Cross-Tenant-Effekt belegt.
preconditions: An operator selects the supported 0.0.0.0 authorization-service bind.
The service port is directly reachable by untrusted clients.
No effective outside-repository proxy, network admission, or timeout control terminates the slow connection first.
reproduction: Read the retained attack-path report for CAND-5A22CBF5-COV003-AUTH-SLOWLORIS-001.
In an authorized local-only harness, hold one incomplete bounded request and issue a normal complete authorization request concurrently.
root_cause: The public bind parser allows 0.0.0.0 while the sole accept loop synchronously performs unbounded blocking reads on each accepted socket. Byte limits and the caller-side Envoy timeout do not impose an absolute deadline on a directly connected slow client.
root_cause_de: Der Public-Bind-Parser erlaubt 0.0.0.0, während die einzige Accept-Schleife auf jedem angenommenen Socket synchron unbegrenzte blockierende Reads ausführt. Byte-Limits und das Caller-seitige Envoy-Timeout setzen für einen direkt verbundenen langsamen Client keine absolute Frist.
proposed_remediation: Add an absolute monotonic complete-request deadline and a bounded admission/concurrency design that retains ordinary-client capacity. Keep loopback/private binding as the default and preserve fail-closed Envoy behavior.
proposed_remediation_de: Eine absolute monotone Gesamt-Request-Frist und ein begrenztes Admission-/Concurrency-Design ergänzen, das Kapazität für normale Clients bewahrt. Loopback-/Private-Bind als Default beibehalten und fail-closed Envoy-Verhalten erhalten.
acceptance_criteria: Slow-reader pressure cannot retain unbounded authorization capacity.
Normal authorization traffic remains available under the configured budgets.
A directly held incomplete request is closed or receives the documented timeout result within the absolute deadline.
Existing Envoy failure_mode_allow false semantics remain unchanged.
validation_plan: Use an authorized isolated loopback-only harness with a non-sensitive rule configuration.
Hold one bounded incomplete header or body request and send a complete authorization request concurrently.
Verify timeout/closure for the stalled client, timely expected decision for the ordinary client, queue/admission bounds, and loopback defaults in both wrappers.
regression_tests: Add a deterministic slow partial request timeout/control test.
Add a concurrent ordinary authorization allow/block control under the same configured budget.
Retain wrapper configuration assertions that shipped authorization endpoints remain loopback.
legitimate_control_tests: Run a complete ordinary authorization request through both selected wrapper profiles.
Verify the existing Envoy fail-closed timeout and Traefik loopback defaults remain intact.
blocked_by: Direct public deployment reachability is unobserved.
No authorized slow-client versus ordinary-client runtime control has yet run.
residual_risk: The service remains Low/P3 conditional risk if an operator directly exposes its supported public bind. Shipped profiles are loopback-only but that does not remove the explicitly supported public-bind path. No risk is accepted.
residual_risk_de: Der Service bleibt ein bedingtes Low-/P3-Risiko, wenn ein Operator seinen unterstützten Public-Bind direkt exponiert. Ausgelieferte Profile sind loopbackgebunden, beseitigen aber nicht den ausdrücklich unterstützten Public-Bind-Pfad. Es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.

Current-target analysis identified the specific 0.0.0.0 direct-bind, synchronous receive, and serial accept path. It remains validated Low/P3, not a claim that shipped Envoy or Traefik default profiles expose the service publicly.
